name: Add Contact to List
description: Adds a contact to a specific static list. [See the documentation](https://legacydocs.hubspot.com/docs/methods/lists/add_contact_to_list)

configurable_props.name: list
configurable_props.label: List
configurable_props.description: The list which the contact will be added to. Only static lists are shown here, as dynamic lists cannot be manually added to.

configurable_props.name: contactEmail
configurable_props.label: Contact Email
configurable_props.description: The email of the contact to be added to the list. Note - this needs to be a contact that already exists within HubSpot. You may need to add a Create or Update Contact step before this one. Then, use the email created in that step in this field.
